stories.explanation: Objectif de chiffre d’affaires à 2030 présenté à la journée investisseurs.
stories.story_fr: Amkor vise environ 11 milliards de dollars de chiffre d’affaires ou plus en 2030, contre 6,7 milliards en 2025.
stories.story_en: Amkor targets about $11 billion of revenue or more by 2030, versus $6.7 billion in 2025.
stories.citation: The company presented long‑term financial targets showing planned revenue growth from $6.7 billion in 2025 to about $11 billion or more by 2030, with gross margin expansion from 14% to roughly 22% and earnings per share potentially more than tripling.

stories.story_fr: Amkor vise une marge brute d’environ 22 %, contre 14 % en 2025.
stories.story_en: Amkor targets a gross margin of roughly 22%, up from 14% in 2025.
stories.citation: The company presented long‑term financial targets showing planned revenue growth from $6.7 billion in 2025 to about $11 billion or more by 2030, with gross margin expansion from 14% to roughly 22% and earnings per share potentially more than tripling.

stories.explanation: Objectif de bénéfice par action à 2030.
stories.story_fr: Amkor vise un bénéfice par action d’environ 5 dollars ou plus en 2030.
stories.story_en: Amkor targets earnings per share of about $5.00 or more by 2030.
stories.citation: Long-term targets: ~ $11B+ revenue, ~22%+ gross margin and ~$5.00+ EPS by 2030.
